sentences.text: The cited in-force UCB directions say a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges in the covered cases, but they do not state any monetary penalty amount for doing so. (E11, E12, E14)
The earlier foreclosure-charge circulars are shown as superseded or withdrawn and therefore do not supply a current penalty amount on 2026-11-23. (R1, R2, E1, E5, E7)

missing.searched: Searched the in-force UCB pre-payment-charge directions and the superseded foreclosure-charge circulars for any RBI monetary penalty for levying prohibited foreclosure charges, but no penalty amount was stated.
